Terms of Service

Last updated 27 August 2026

What Be Good is

Be Good is a membership app. Your membership pays for using the app and for the right to choose, each month, a person who receives a coin from you.

A coin is a record inside the app. It is not a physical object, nothing is posted, and it has no cash value and cannot be exchanged, sold or transferred.

It is not a shop. You are not buying a coin, and you are not buying anything for yourself.

You may never be chosen

Coins are given by other members. Nobody is assigned to you, and nothing entitles you to receive anything.

You may go months without being chosen, and you may never be chosen at all. That is how Be Good works and is not a fault in the service.

Who can join

You must be 18 or older. You must give a first name that people can reasonably call you, and a working email address.

One person, one account. Accounts created to collect coins dishonestly will be closed, and any coins collected through them removed.

What other members see

Other members see your first name, your photo and the few lines you write about yourself. Nothing else, ever.

Your email address is visible only to you. We do not ask for your last name, your postal address or your phone number, and we do not hold them.

How a coin is created

A coin exists only because a member spent one of the choices their membership gives them. There is no other way for one to come into being, and no member can create, edit or add to their own count.

Your total is counted from the coins other people gave you. We may remove a coin that came from a payment that was reversed, or from an account we close for breaking these terms.

One coin a month, per person

A member can be chosen at most once in a calendar month. Once someone has been chosen, they cannot be chosen again until the next month.

This exists so that coins reach as many people as possible rather than gathering around a few.

The prize draw, and where we can post

Collecting five coins enters you in our prize draw automatically. There is nothing to fill in and nothing to send.

Prizes, unlike coins, are real objects and are posted. We post to addresses in the fifty United States and the District of Columbia only, and we do not use freight forwarders or mail forwarding services. A member who lives outside the United States can collect coins and use every other part of Be Good, but cannot be awarded a prize.

You are asked where you live when you create your account, and you must answer. We tell you what it means before your account is created and again before you are charged. If you later change that answer, everything above applies from the moment you change it.

A prize is awarded only to a member whose email address has been confirmed, because we cannot send a prize to somebody we cannot reach. The full rules of the draw are published in the app and on our website, and anybody may read them without entering.

Payment, renewal and cancelling

Membership is billed through the app store you installed from, and renews until you cancel. Cancel any time from your store account; your membership runs to the end of the period you have paid for.

Once you have spent a choice, the coin is in the other person's collection and cannot be called back. Refunds are handled by the app store under its own policy.

Messages between members

A private chat opens only after someone receives your coin and taps the heart. Either person may block or report the other at any time.

Do not share your address, phone number, financial details or passwords in chat. Be Good will never ask you for them.

Behaviour

Be kind. Do not harass, threaten, deceive or impersonate anyone. Do not upload a photo that is not of you, or that is sexual, violent or hateful.

Every picture uploaded to Be Good is checked automatically and may also be looked at by a person afterwards. A picture can therefore be removed after it has already appeared. If that happens we tell you in the app and you may add another one.

We may hide content, suspend an account or close it where these terms are broken.

Closing your account

You can delete your account from Settings at any time. That removes your profile, your photo, the lines you wrote and your coins.

Coins you gave to other people stay with them. Records we must keep for tax or fraud purposes are kept for as long as the law requires.

Changes

If we change these terms in a way that matters, we will tell you in the app before the change takes effect.
